description: Index of all drop-in AI personas in the NAVIG registry. Install one with `navig install add persona:navig-run/registry/personas/<id>`, then pick it as your AI persona in the Deck (Settings → AI & Models → AI persona). Entries without a marketplace block are free.

personas.name: Senior Engineer
personas.description: Battle-tested senior software engineer — root-cause analysis, clean architecture, reliable code
